summary: No Parking Any Time kerb on a through road, with homes 13-17 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Parkland and trees on the van's side, but flats and houses 13-17 m away across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lane with no verge or pull-in; the kerb abuts trees and a grass bank beside the creek.
drivers.traffic: Through route linking the Heroes Avenue junction to Indooroopilly Road.
drivers.convention: Three No Parking Any Time signs cover the stretch; no cars park here.

flags: Low-lying: 3.5-5.3 m elevation, Toowong Creek 19 m away
sun_shade: Tree canopy shades the kerb from the north and east; open to sun from the west.
